args.body:
## Summary
`src/money.py` used `ROUND_HALF_UP` despite its docstring and FIN-212 requiring banker's rounding (`ROUND_HALF_EVEN`). This caused the nightly build to fail on `tests/test_money.py`.

## Change
- Switched the rounding mode in `round_money` to `ROUND_HALF_EVEN`.
- No behavior change for non-tie cases; ties (e.g., `2.665` → `2.66`) now round half-to-even as required by FIN-212.

## Verification
- CI run `ci-0001` on `08d3cd5986` passed, including `tests/test_money.py`.
args.head: fix/bankers-rounding-fin-212
args.title: Fix banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212

Note docstring already says banker's rounding; fix import and rounding param. Create branch, commit.
